candidates.exact_span: The monthly average water quality based effluent concentration necessary to meet the state water quality standards as developed in the approved technically based local limits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This passage ties enforceable limits to monthly-average, water-quality-based effluent concentrations derived from approved technically based local limits; interpreting whether these are operative numeric compliance limits (versus informational reporting) or how the monthly-average basis applies could change which limit is selected for comparison against reported measurements.

candidates.exact_span: The results of all influent and effluent analyses performed pursuant to Part II(A)(1)(c) above
candidates.computation_change_reason: The cross-reference to Part II(A)(1)(c) defines which influent and effluent analyses are in scope; a different reading of that referenced monitoring provision would change which monitoring requirements are evaluated as applicable (Purpose B) and which reported results or absences are treated as the relevant evidence base (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: All effluent monitoring conducted in accordance with Part (II) (A) (1) (c) above shall meet the Minimum Quantification Levels (MQLs) shown in MQL's at Appendix A of Part II below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This clause makes MQL compliance a condition on effluent monitoring under Part II(A)(1)(c); interpreting the MQL threshold, its Appendix A values, or whether a result meets quantification could change whether a numeric limit comparison is applicable (Purpose A), whether the monitoring obligation is satisfied (Purpose B), and whether a sub-MQL or non-quantified result is classified as an ordinary numeric result versus a missing/qualified-evidence state (Purpose C).
